Future<void> save(Object? x) async {}

// CASE dart_multi_arrow expect=pass
void a1(List<int> ids, List<Future<void> Function()> handlers) {
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    handlers.add(() async => await save(ids[i]));
  }
}

// CASE dart_multi_block expect=pass
void a2(List<int> ids, List<Future<void> Function()> handlers) {
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    handlers.add(() async {
      await save(ids[i]);
    });
  }
}

// CASE dart_reverse_block expect=pass
void a3(List<int> ids, List<Future<void> Function()> handlers) {
  for (var i = ids.length; i-- > 0;) {
    handlers.add(() async {
      await save(ids[i]);
    });
  }
}

// CASE dart_multi_named_fn expect=pass
void a4(List<int> ids, List<Future<void> Function()> handlers) {
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    Future<void> job() async {
      await save(ids[i]);
    }

    handlers.add(job);
  }
}
